name: BananaSMP
description:
Blockfun is a brand new SMP Network! We plan on becoming a one-stop network for all and any SMP gameplay desires! Here's what we've got so far:

• Lifesteal: Fight your enemies, get rich, climb the social ladder and take on exciting challenges!

• Wild Kits: Enhance your PvP skills by challenging formidable rivals, with leaderboards!

• BoxSMP: Land in a world of your own and complete tasks to gain more space!

• EarthSMP: Explore uncharted lands, conquer, trade resources, and build alliances!

We allow both Java and Bedrock players to join!

[Version 1.8 - 1.23]

Server IP: play.blockfun.store

Discord: discord.gg/blockfun
